seo.title: {name} — Restoration & Remodeling in Vancouver, WA
seo.description: Remodeling, mold remediation, and restoration in Vancouver, WA — without the chaos. Every project comes with a live page: photos, daily updates, and what's next. One team from emergency cleanup to final paint.

hero.title: A person answers.
hero.sub: Water, fire & mold restoration · Vancouver WA & Portland · 24/7
hero.save: We text you back from this same number — save it.

steps.title: A person picks up.
steps.text: Day or night — not a menu.

steps.title: We tell you what to do first.
Everything is documented.
steps.text: Photos, moisture readings and a scope your adjuster can use.

hero.next: What to do while you wait

steps.title: Shut off the water.
steps.text: Main valve: garage, basement, crawlspace or by the water heater. Clockwise until it stops.

steps.title: Wet near the panel? Don’t touch it.
steps.text: Stay out of that room. Sparks or a burning smell — leave and call 911.

steps.title: Film everything.
steps.text: Wide first, then close. Before you move anything. It helps your claim.

estimate.title: Got the estimate? Send it before you sign anything.
estimate.intro: Adjusters write estimates in Xactimate. So do we. We walk the house, write our own scope line by line, and send it to your adjuster with photos and readings.

points.title: Same language as your adjuster
points.text: Our scope lines up with theirs item by item, so differences are easy to see — and to discuss.

points.title: What often needs a second look
points.text: Flooring that has to match room to room, code-required items once walls are open, cabinets and counters that can’t be patched.

points.title: You’re not the go-between
points.text: Scope, photos and readings go straight to your adjuster as the job runs. You see all of it; you don’t carry it.

estimate.smsBody: Hi Ona — here is my insurance estimate. Address:
estimate.fine: We’re a contractor, not a public adjuster: we document the damage and estimate the work. Your claim stays between you and your insurer.

work.title: Rooms we finished.
work.text: Kitchens, baths and the rebuild after a claim — photographed when we handed them back.

cost.title: If it’s an insurance claim:
cost.line: You pay your deductible, nothing more.
cost.find: It’s on your policy’s declarations page. Can’t find it? Call — we’ll look with you.

faqs.a: Yes. A person answers 24/7 at {phone}. Calls and texts go to the same number.

faqs.q: Do you work with my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. We document the loss — photos, moisture readings, a scope in Xactimate — and share it with your adjuster. Your carrier decides coverage. You pay your deductible, nothing more.

faqs.q: Someone else did the drying. Can you do the rebuild?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us what you have — the estimate, letters, photos — and we’ll walk the job with you.

faqs.q: Do you remodel when nothing is damaged?

faqs.a: Ona Restoration & Remodeling LLC holds Washington contractor registration ONARER*748K8, verifiable at secure.lni.wa.gov/verify. Our technicians are IICRC-certified in water damage restoration, applied structural drying, microbial remediation, and fire and smoke restoration.
